decision_framework.title: Bounded Context Boundary & Mapping Strategy
decision_framework.context: Determining how two distinct business domains should interact and whether to share code, models, or isolate with adapters.

branch.condition: Both subsystems evolve together under the same team with identical business lifecycles
branch.trade_offs: Avoids mapper boilerplate; trade-off: changes in the shared kernel require synchronized releases between subsystems.
branch.anti_pattern: Never use Shared Kernel across different teams or disparate deployment cadences.

branch.condition: One subsystem depends on a foreign third-party API or legacy system with unstable/messy schemas
branch.trade_offs: Insulates internal domain models completely from external churn; trade-off: requires maintenance of bi-directional DTO mappers.
branch.anti_pattern: Do not expose foreign schema properties inside internal domain services.

branch.condition: Subsystems belong to different business subdomains (e.g. Ingestion/RAG vs User Billing)
branch.recommendation: Autonomous Bounded Contexts with Duplicate DTOs
branch.trade_offs: Guarantees 100% independent deployability and zero hidden coupling; trade-off: violates strict DRY across domain boundaries.
branch.anti_pattern: Do not attempt to unify User and Customer into a single monolithic entity class.
